prompt: Get the latest contact from Go.Data, set its dateOfReporting to today's date, and upload it as a customer to Mailchimp.
workflow_yaml:
name: dry-run
jobs:
  fetch:
    name: Fetch record
    adaptor: '@openfn/language-godata@latest'
    body: |
      listContacts('ob-sl-covid19');
  post:
    name: Post record
    adaptor: '@openfn/language-mailchimp@latest'
    body: |
      fn(state => {
        const c = state.data[state.data.length - 1];
        state.member = { email_address: c.email || c.addresses?.[0]?.emailAddress, status: 'subscribed',
          merge_fields: { FNAME: c.firstName, LNAME: c.lastName, REPORTED: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10) } };
        return state;
      });
      addMember({ listId: 'list_seed01', member: state => state.member });
triggers:
  webhook:
    type: webhook
edges:
  webhook->fetch:
    source_trigger: webhook
    target_job: fetch
  fetch->post:
    source_job: fetch
    target_job: post
    condition_type: on_job_success
